messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Canary probe failing in us-east-1 for model text-gen-1 — 3 consecutive 5xx responses (probe_id=canary/us-east/text-gen-1/2026-02-18_03:45:11). See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-failures :rotating_light:

maria: saw this hit my phone. I'm on it. Starting triage, tagging @sam and @kai for infra checks. Can we confirm customer-facing impact?

sam: checking logs now. Initial look — backend returned 502s for the probe payload, but service metrics (qps, p99) for text-gen-1 don't show large customer latency spikes. Could be probe-specific. Pulling probe runner logs.

maria: good. if it's probe-only we should avoid paging SREs. I'll run a quick raw curl against the instance that the probe hit.

sam: pasted runner log snippet:
```
2026-02-18T03:44:56Z probe_runner[pid=2241] request=POST /v1/generate -> upstream 502 Bad Gateway
2026-02-18T03:45:00Z probe_runner retry=1 -> upstream 502
2026-02-18T03:45:10Z probe_runner failing_count=3 -> marking probe FATAL
```
Looks like short-lived upstream 502s. No flood in error budget yet.

kai: checking infra: no instance replacement or autoscaler events at the timestamps. Network overlay logs show a brief spike of proxy errors in us-east-1 for ~70s. Might be a transient LB config flapping or a throttled control plane call.

maria: thinking out loud — this is a classic noisy canary: probe interval 30s + failure_threshold 3 => single transient ~70s can trigger an alert and page. We should temporarily increase thresholds and follow up with probe tuning. Propose: interval -> 120s, failure_threshold -> 5. Also add stability window so multiple unique probes must fail.

jess: +1. We get paged for these several times a week. But let's be cautious: we don't want to mask real regressions. Suggest making the change region-scoped (us-east-1) and revert after 24h if stable, then create a task to run A/B test for new settings.

sam: I'm comfortable with regional temp change. I'll patch canary config now and validate. Command I'm using (ops token required):
```
curl -X PATCH "https://ops-api.redwood.internal/v1/canaries/us-east/text-gen-1" \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"interval":"120s","failure_threshold":5,"stability_window":"10m"}'
```
I'll monitor for the next 30 minutes.

ops-bot: CONFIG UPDATE accepted (change_id=cfg-98421). New config applied to canary/us-east/text-gen-1 at 2026-02-18T03:52:34Z.

maria: thanks @sam. Can you also add a temporary grafana panel to the oncall dashboard showing canary success rate + proxy 5xx for the last 1h so we can observe correlation? Link it under incidents dash.

sam: added panel: https://grafana.internal/d/onsla/canary-watch?panelId=7 — shows success rate and proxy_5xx. Early signs: success rate recovered after ~90s and has been steady at 100% for 10m. Proxy errors dropped to baseline.

kai: infra note: control plane reported a config push to the LB infra at 03:44:45Z which overlapped with a rollout, causing ~70s of proxy 502s. I've flagged the LB rollout team to avoid rolling during maintenance windows.

jess: good root cause direction. Action items: 1) temporary regional threshold change (done), 2) add canary stability_window config and run A/B test across regions (owner: maria), 3) LB rollout scheduling policy update (owner: kai), 4) post-incident doc + runbook tweak (owner: jess).

maria: I'm handing off monitoring for the next 2 hours to @sam. I'll file the follow-up ticket now. Taking a break — ping me if it looks like customer impact. :wave:

sam: acknowledged, taking over. I'll keep the panel open. If we see >2 consecutive failing probes across regions within 10m we'll escalate.

jess: quick note for the postmortem — recommend adding a probe variant that exercises a longer payload and random source IPs so we can better detect LB-level regressions. Also consider increasing probe jitter to avoid synchronized effects.

maria: created ticket RED-3127: "Canary tuning: stability_window, interval experiment, LB rollout guardrails" with links to logs and dashboard. ETA for initial experiment plan: EOD Friday.

incidents-bot: Incident closed (no customer impact detected, config change rolled out to us-east-1, follow-ups created). Summary: transient LB rollout overlap caused ~70s proxy 502s, triggered 3/30s canary policy -> page. Mitigations: increased regional probe interval + threshold, added stability_window, monitoring panel added.

jess: thanks everyone — nice rapid triage and low blast. We'll review in the weekly SRE sync. :thumbsup:
